prompt_text: Donor CRM that integrates with QuickBooks Online
response_text:
**Several donor CRMs integrate with QuickBooks Online, including Donorbox, CharityEngine, DonorDock, DonorPerfect, and Bloomerang.** These tools automate syncing donations, transactions, and donor data to eliminate manual entry and ensure accurate financial records.[1][2][3][5][9]

### Key Options and Features
| CRM | Integration Highlights | Sync Details | Cost/Notes |
|-----|------------------------|--------------|------------|
| **Donorbox** | Native integration syncs one-time/recurring donations, ticket sales as Sales Receipts or Invoices + Payments.[1] | Automatic after setup wizard; maps to existing QB accounts/products; requires QB Plus+ for Classes/Locations; $50/month add-on. | Best for nonprofits of all sizes; dashboard for sync status.[1] |
| **CharityEngine** | Dual sync options: Detailed (donor records) for small orgs; Batch for large orgs with gross deposit reconciliation.[2] | Effortless, no uploads; handles fees, automatic returns sync. | Superior for scaling nonprofits; supports QB Online/Enterprise.[2] |
| **DonorDock** | Auto-syncs donations/transactions as sales receipts; links gift numbers for navigation.[3] | Focuses on accounting side; no manual entry needed. | Streamlines data without handling payments directly.[3] |
| **DonorPerfect** | Syncs gifts/expenses; posts as individual/daily/monthly summaries; maps donors to QB customers.[5][7] | Real-time data; multiple bank accounts/classes; journal entries; works with QB Online/Desktop. | Cloud-based; purchase QB through them; trusted Solution Provider.[4][5][7][8] |
| **Bloomerang** | Granular data mapping to specific QB accounts; supports Online/Desktop.[9] | Seamless sync of donations/finances; reduces errors. | Custom alignment for donor funds and records.[9] |

Neon CRM also integrates for donor tracking and financial reporting, per 2026 evaluations emphasizing ease and accuracy.[6] Choose based on org size—e.g., Donorbox/CharityEngine for automation depth, DonorPerfect for comprehensive nonprofit CRM features. All prioritize real-time or automated syncing to QuickBooks Online.[1][2][5][6]
